phoenix-rpcna-az.assessment: Phoenix RPC Mission is an RPCNA church plant in metropolitan Phoenix — Arizona is extraordinarily thin for confessional Reformed Presbyterian options, and especially so for the Covenanter tradition. As a mission/plant, ministerial supply and meeting location should be verified through RPCNA Pacific Coast Presbytery before contact. Standard RPCNA confessional posture: Westminster subscription, exclusive psalmody, a cappella worship, male-only ordination. Mission status flagged for verification.

score_notes.gender: RPCNA strictly complementarian — male-only elders and deacons.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders (or mission session); presbytery oversight.

score_notes.mens_discipleship: Standard RPCNA men's study programming; verify.
score_notes.denominational: RPCNA mission/plant — Pacific Coast Presbytery oversight.

phoenix-urc-az.assessment: Phoenix URC is a confessional Continental Reformed plant in metropolitan Phoenix — Arizona is thin for URCNA presence outside this congregation. Standard URCNA pattern: Three Forms of Unity subscription, male-only officers, two-service Lord's Day, Heidelberg Catechism preaching. A meaningful option for confessional Reformed believers in the Phoenix metro where the confessional Reformed footprint skews PCA/OPC.

score_notes.scripture: Three Forms of Unity — inerrancy and sufficiency.
score_notes.gender: Male-only officers per URCNA Church Order.
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of male elders; classis-level accountability.
score_notes.cultural: Conservative confessional Reformed; no progressive drift detected.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men's study groups characteristic of URCNA; verify programming.
score_notes.denominational: URCNA, Classis Southwest US. Two services + catechetical preaching.
